name: Cresswell Towers Holiday Park
accommodation: Self-catering caravans with 2 or 3 bedrooms, sleeping up to 8
beachAccess: A short stroll to the sands of Druridge Bay
confirmedFeatures: Heated indoor pool (seasonal), playground, sports court, arcade, showbar, bar and restaurant, Costa Coffee, takeaway
overview: A Parkdean Resorts park in a woodland setting at Cresswell, at the southern end of Druridge Bay. It offers self-catering caravans with an indoor pool, bar and restaurant, and evening entertainment. The sands of Druridge Bay are a short walk from the park.
surfTripFit: Walking access to Druridge Bay and plenty on site for non-surfers makes it a family surf base.
